title: Electronic weighing in-motion systems, Part 1: Terminology and design rules
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 11547 (PART 1)) prescribes technical specifications, requirements, tolerances, and testing procedures for Electronic weighing in-motion systems, Part 1: Terminology and design rules.

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
